name: Itchy Wombat 76
author: AKAspidey01
description: Rounded red checkbox that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: transform becomes rotate(45deg) translateY(0.7em) translateX(0.7em), transform becomes rotate(-45deg) translateY(0em) translateX(0.1em), transform becomes scaleX(0).
